message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "The attacker-controlled string entryName from ZipEntry.getName() is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName), and the resulting File f is used directly in new FileOutputStream(f). There is no containment check, canonical-path comparison, or allow-list ensuring that f remains under the destination directory, so an archive entry name containing ../ can write files outside dir."}]}
